definitions.gloss: commercial district; commercial area; business zone
definitions.explanation: An area designated or used primarily for shops, offices, and other commercial activities. Used in both urban planning and everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{商業地|しょうぎょうち}だ。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{商業地|しょうぎょうち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{発展|はってん}した→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧。
examples.english: The area in front of the station developed as a commercial district.

examples.japanese: {商業地|しょうぎょうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地価|ちか}→地価：12130_chika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{住宅地|じゅうたくち}→住宅地：10158_juutakuchi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Land prices in commercial districts tend to be higher than in residential areas.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧ (commerce) + {地|ち} (land/area).

LAND USE TYPES:
- {商業地|しょうぎょうち}: commercial area
- ⟦{住宅地|じゅうたくち}→住宅地：10158_juutakuchi⟧: residential area
- {工業地|こうぎょうち}: industrial area
- ⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧: farmland

RELATED WORDS:
- {商業地域|しょうぎょうちいき}: commercial zone (official urban planning category)
- {商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}: commercial facility (shopping mall, etc.)
- ⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧: busy shopping/entertainment district

USAGE:
Appears in urban planning, real estate, and news contexts. ⟦{地価|ちか}→地価：12130_chika⟧ (land prices) in {商業地|しょうぎょうち} are typically higher than in residential areas. Station-front areas (⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧) are often {商業地|しょうぎょうち}.
